mapper.select: select total_amount, currency from tbl_order where ono = #{ono}

select oip.pno, oip.ptitle_ko, oip.pfilename, oip.price, oip.oiqty, o.total_amount from tbl_order o left join (select oi.ono, oi.oiqty, p.pno, p.ptitle_ko, p.pfilename, p.price from tbl_order_item oi left join tbl_product p on oi.pno = p.pno ) oip on oip.ono = o.ono where o.ono = #{ono}
